A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Uni-Instruct. Their main text, equations, proofs, algorithms, experimental tables, figures, and appendices are readable and can be matched despite substantial reordering.

before.justification: v2 reports original Uni-Instruct image-generation results, component ablations, and NeRF/mesh evaluations in Tables 1-4 and 7.

after.justification: v3 retains these original results and adds metric and training-convergence comparisons in Tables 6-7.

M1.justification: v3 adds a factor of two to the SIM loss component in Eq. 3.6, also reflected in Eq. 3.3. This changes the stated objective's scaling; the architecture and algorithm steps remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether implementation or training changed.

E1.justification: Both evaluate conditional and unconditional CIFAR10 generation, conditional ImageNet64 generation, and the same text-to-3D prompts using NeRF and mesh representations. The additional metrics and training checkpoints retain this coverage.

E2.justification: Removing v2 Figure 1 removes plotted ImageNet comparisons including DMD and IMM, which are absent from v3's corresponding benchmark table. Existing tabular and 3D comparator sets remain intact; the additional metric comparisons reuse SiDA.

E3.justification: v3 adds evaluations using sFID, FD_DINO, inception score, precision, and recall, plus FID measurements at five training checkpoints in Tables 6-7. These extend the evaluation protocol without revising the stated settings of the retained experiments.

E4.justification: Table 6 adds a convergence comparison against SiDA, examining FID across five checkpoints and reporting lower Uni-Instruct FID at each. The existing divergence, GAN-loss, and initialization ablations are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both checklists state that the random seed was fixed and error bars were omitted because of computational costs. v3 adds no repeated-run counts, uncertainty estimates, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 6-7 add metric scores and training-checkpoint FIDs; for example, ImageNet FD_DINO is 60.86 for Uni-Instruct versus 74.86 for SiDA. Removing Figure 1 also removes plot-only performance entries. The retained benchmark, ablation, and 3D table values and generated samples are unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendix B.2 revises v2 Appendix A.2 by correcting density-ratio orientations and integration/expectation measures in Eqs. B.32-B.34 and B.44, adding the factor of two in B.48, and discussing sample dependence when differentiating the score discrepancy. These are local mathematical revisions within the retained theoretical framework.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the claims of unifying more than ten methods, obtaining tractable equivalent losses, achieving leading generation performance, and supporting text-to-3D generation. The headline abstract FIDs remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 4.2 newly interprets results as faster convergence, better semantic preservation, and robustness to more complex, high-resolution synthesis. The interpretation overstates Table 7: three ImageNet metrics improve, although the text claims four. Appendix F's computational-cost, instability, and convergence limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v3 adds a specific GitHub link for the promised code in the abstract; v2 only gives a generic future-release statement. Existing implementation and 3D training details are retained. The PDFs do not establish actual repository availability.

R1.justification: The bibliography is unchanged, but the introduction replaces Diff-Instruct with SIM as an inspiration for the 3D experiments. Appendix B.2 also adds a substantive comparison of FGM and SIM's treatment of sample dependence in gradient calculations.

P1.justification: The document is substantially reorganized: related work moves from the main text to Appendix A, the checklist moves before the appendices, and the standalone practical-algorithms appendix is dissolved into the method and 3D sections. Most prose is retained, with limited copyediting and author/header updates.

P2.justification: v2's introductory plot and conceptual diagram are removed, its appendix unification table becomes introductory Table 1, and Algorithm 1 moves into the main text. v3 adds paired metric/convergence tables and rearranges benchmark displays. The remaining generated-image figures are reused.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves evidential depth by supplementing FID with quality/diversity metrics and convergence checkpoints, while correcting local coefficient and density-ratio inconsistencies. The gain is limited by overstated interpretation: Table 7 supports three improved ImageNet metrics, not four, and the claimed high-resolution robustness is not directly tested.
